article.title: 은/는 después de 만 en 만은 아니다
article.part: Estructura informativa y alcance — 정보 구조와 범위
article.chapter: Alcance e interacción de partículas — 보조사의 범위와 상호작용

claims.summary: Jeon (2025, resumen, pp. 167–200) analiza 만은 아니- como una estrategia para resolver la ambigüedad de 만 아니-: 은/는 añade su significado y fuerza la lectura en que 아니- niega la exclusión expresada por 만, no el elemento focal precedente.

locator.exactCoverage: Abstract: reports that man ani- can be ambiguous between negating the preceding focus and negating exclusion; adding a particle such as eun after man prevents the first interpretation. The article metadata identifies the source as Jeon, 2025, Korean Semantics 87, pp. 167–200. This entry is restricted to 만은 아니다 and does not infer co-occurrence on separate noun phrases.
